steps.label: Biofortification defined
steps.margin_note: Definition with all the nutrient types and the purpose.
lines: BIOFORTIFICATION is the breeding of crops with
HIGHER LEVELS of vitamins and minerals, or higher
protein or healthier fats, in order to improve
steps.why: Improving the nutritional value of the staple crop reaches everyone who already eats it, with no change in diet or behaviour needed.
common_mistakes: Saying biofortification means adding vitamins to food after harvest. It is BRED INTO the crop.
Leaving out public health. That is the purpose.
steps.memory_tip: Put the nutrient in the crop, not in a pill.

steps.why: Each example fortifies a crop people already eat every day, which is what makes the approach work at scale.
